verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for an AI app builder with a CLI and SDK, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting, environment variable, or flag. The CLI, SDK, and MCP documentation covers unrelated capabilities.
